name: protolint-transactional-auto-disable-planning
instr:
protolint cannot preview complete auto-disable changes or apply them atomically across all affected protocol-buffer source files. Make previewed and applied plans deterministic without changing placement or lint behavior.

Have each placement strategy produce deferred edits against unchanged source, preserving Next, ThisThenNext, and Noop semantics. Normalize by source position and stable rule identity. Two rules at one offset produce one result in configured rule order. Conflicts fail with `ErrConflictingAutoDisableEdits` from `github.com/yoheimuta/protolint/linter/autodisable`, exactly `conflicting auto-disable edits`. Missing or changed sources fail atomically with `ErrStaleAutoDisablePlan`, exactly `stale auto-disable plan`.

Pair each detected supported declaration failure with its complete plan. Traversal failure yields nothing applicable. Apply enabled-rule ordering, defaults, additions, removals, file filters, and directory filters identically to diagnostics and plans. Preview emits one byte-stable JSON plan ordered lexically by path without modifying source. Combining preview with fixing or applying auto-disable fails before lint processing with `ErrIncompatibleAutoDisableMode` from `github.com/yoheimuta/protolint/lib`, exactly `incompatible auto-disable mode`.

Keep `NewPlacementStrategy(ptype PlacementType, filename, ruleID string) (PlacementStrategy, error)` in `github.com/yoheimuta/protolint/linter/autodisable` and `ParseAutoDisableProto(source []byte, filename s
